outside.name: The Fool
outside.text: Alpha and omega, ‘divine folly.’ The entry point into the wheel and the beginning of the journey.

outside.name: The World
outside.text: A ‘reset,’ completion of the cycle. The exit from the wheel and readiness for a new beginning.

oven.name: Aries
oven.work: The beginning of the agricultural year. Lead the herds out, take possession of land, ‘set boundary markers’: this is mine, I will sow here.
oven.text: A sign of beginnings and force that breaks through obstacles. Aries needs to choose the direction independently and cannot bear being held back.
oven.plus: Determination, courage, initiative, the ability to start from nothing.
oven.minus: Impatience, a quick temper, beginning before understanding the consequences.

telec.name: Taurus
telec.work: Nature comes into bloom. ‘The Emperor marks boundaries’ — he pulls the plow and cuts the earth into straight lines.
telec.text: Practicality and stability. Taurus creates a reliable, enduring world and dislikes abrupt change.
telec.plus: Patience, reliability, practicality, the ability to preserve what has been accumulated.
telec.minus: Inertia, stubbornness, holding on to the familiar for too long.

bliznecy.name: Gemini
bliznecy.work: Seeking a mate; ‘birds build nests.’ The principle of choosing the right from the wrong (weeding).
bliznecy.text: They learn about the world through contact and information. They learn quickly and switch easily.
bliznecy.plus: Curiosity, flexibility, sociability, connecting people and ideas.
bliznecy.minus: Scattered attention, poor concentration, too many things at once.

rak.name: Cancer
rak.work: Cut the grass, hide it in stacks, and take it by cart beneath the protection of structures — hay for winter.
rak.text: Experiences the world emotionally. Needs protection, personal space, and a sense of home.
rak.plus: Empathy, care, memory, intuition, emotional depth.

lev.name: Leo
lev.work: Harvest time, ‘the most important time of the year.’ One must master oneself — the desire to be idle is strong, but work cannot stop.
lev.text: Putting oneself into a task and feeling that one’s presence matters. Vivid self-expression and recognition.
lev.plus: Creativity, confidence, generosity, leadership, the ability to inspire.
lev.minus: Pride, a painful response to being disregarded, a need for praise.

deva.name: Virgo
deva.work: Working alone as the day grows shorter. Separate grain from chaff, sort it, spin yarn.
deva.text: Notices details, analyzes, corrects, and improves. Sees what can be adjusted more precisely.
deva.plus: Analytical ability, accuracy, practicality, breaking a task into parts.

vesy.name: Libra
vesy.work: Fairs and scales; negotiating with merchants; taxes and tithes — ‘an offering to authority.’
vesy.text: Naturally sees the opposing point of view. Partnership, fairness, and harmony matter.
vesy.plus: Diplomacy, negotiating ability, a sense of proportion, seeing several points of view.
vesy.minus: Indecision, weighing options for too long.

skorpion.name: Scorpio
skorpion.work: Sowing winter crops, the ‘burial of the grain.’ We hide what cannot be eaten and give it to God/Pluto.
skorpion.text: An intense inner life. Drawn to hidden causes, crises, power, and transformation.
skorpion.plus: Insight, resilience, depth of feeling, the ability to rebuild after crisis.
skorpion.minus: Suspicion, jealousy, possessiveness, a drive to control.

strelec.name: Sagittarius
strelec.work: The last attempt to gather acorns using pigs, forest grazing. Weddings and celebrations marking the end of the year.
strelec.text: Seeks to move beyond the known. Drawn to new knowledge, philosophy, and broad prospects.
strelec.plus: Optimism, broad thinking, curiosity, inspiration through an idea.
strelec.minus: Scattered effort, overestimating one’s strength, promising more than one can deliver.

kozerog.name: Capricorn
kozerog.work: The ‘turning of the year,’ Christmas/Saturnalia — the hourglass turns over. Survival on stored supplies.
kozerog.text: Thinks in terms of results, structure, time, and responsibility. Sets long-term goals.
kozerog.plus: Responsibility, patience, discipline, strategy, endurance under pressure.
kozerog.minus: Excessive seriousness, pessimism, rigidity, postponing life until ‘later.’

vodoley.name: Aquarius
vodoley.work: Wash barrels, channel meltwater, carry out active communal work. Protect livestock from wolves.
vodoley.text: Views familiar rules from the outside. Drawn to new ideas, technology, and freedom of thought.
vodoley.plus: Independence, originality, inventiveness, seeing new options.
vodoley.minus: Detachment, stubbornness, rebellion for its own sake, difficulty with commitments.

ryby.name: Pisces
ryby.work: The hardest time of year — supplies have run out. ‘One fish moves forward, the other back; one is black, the other white.’
ryby.text: Receptive to the atmosphere and other people’s moods. A rich imagination and strong intuition.
ryby.minus: Blurred boundaries, indecision, withdrawal from reality, self-sacrifice.
